document_kind: Descriptive report and artifact interface snapshot; not agent instructions or executable configuration.
python: conda run -n py314 python; XeLaTeX/latexmk for PDFs
main_policy: run.py/official_run.py default refined for Q3 and field for Q4, with explicit --strategy override; this decision uses non-paired supplied practice diagnosis and local paired confirmation. Both use .22 probes. Q3 ring1200/center/unknown; Q4 compact25/guarded/useful. Field adds bounded route portfolio plus one conditional pre-localization in-place measure; Q3 additionally conservative negative geometry and safe near-side clear. Q4 forbids negative disk inference and approach_clear=False. Fixed probes, finite recovery and rectangle optical cover remain.
denominators: Development 3100000..3100149: 150 worlds per problem, six Q3 and eleven Q4 configurations, 2550 runs. Frozen main 4100000..4100999: 1000 worlds per problem, three Q3 and four Q4 configurations, 7000 runs. Stress 4200000..4200049: three scenarios, three errors, two policies, two problems, 1800 runs. Random alternate errors 4210000..4210199: two errors, two policies, two problems, 1600 runs. Sensitivity 4300000..4300049: three scales, two problems, 300 runs. Frozen research total 10700; historical 4430/3080/2200 datasets remain separate.
field_denominators: Development 6100000..6100149: 150 worlds/problem, seven Q3 and eight Q4 configurations, 2250 runs. Confirmation main 7100000..7100999: 1000 worlds/problem, four Q3 and two Q4 configurations, 6000 runs; stress 7200000..7200049: three scenarios x three errors x two policies x two problems, 1800; random alternate errors 7210000..7210199: two errors x two policies x two problems, 1600. Total 9400; Q4 clustered/smooth saving CI crosses zero. Core replay total 34610; fast auxiliary 2000 separate.

assets_interface.research_metadata: metadata.json, enhancement_metadata.json, research_metadata.json, official_practice_metadata.json and field_metadata.json in report/generated expose input_sha256 mapping archive-relative inputs to SHA-256, checked before packaging and before/after extracted replay. Field generator owns field_metadata input hashes.
assets_interface.historical_assets: Base and enhancement assets remain generated separately. geometry.pdf and q2_lens.pdf support Q1/Q2; ring_sweep evidence and historical seven-point/lattice comparisons retain their original labels and denominators.
assets_interface.metrics: Per-world T/N means, medians and p90, not pooled T divided by pooled N. Paired saving is control minus candidate; stress regressions and intervals crossing zero are reported. Development screens are not held-out evidence.
assets_interface.rendering: Booktabs table fragments are included by paper.tex; vector figures use English axes/legends. Source listings use English docstrings/comments where possible. report/research_theory.tex is an input narrative, not an additional full source listing.

support_interface: report/appendix.tex lists all necessary runnable sources, including make_research_assets.py, new field/negative/route modules, field study/confirmation/verifier/assets and canonical official_analysis.py. report/ai_usage.tex identifies verifiable mcm/gpt-6-astra through Oh My Pi, core contributions, 20 supplied official practices and outstanding formal/manual evidence. reproduce.txt provides ordered extracted-root commands and field/refined GUI-safe examples.
archive_verification: package.py --verify checks manifest/5 asset input/PDF/practice hashes, anonymous paths, <=20MiB and abstract/body<=30 pages. A temporary extraction with PYTHONPATH removed executes full previous commands plus official_analysis.py --handoff practice_data, verify_field, field_study, field_confirmation and make_field_assets. Exact ordered content is compared across all 34610 core runs; only local real_duration_s/max_real_duration_s/max_real_s excluded. fast auxiliary 2000 is separate. Immutable source/practice hashes and asset input hashes are rechecked at end; official input files are never regenerated. All assets and both PDFs rebuilt. Failures propagate, no subset replacement.
official_evidence: 20 user-supplied official practice observations, ten per question, are independently costed from manifest and 60 sanitized raw files included under practice_data after identity/path checks. Canonical official_analysis.py records every input SHA-256. Strict baseline action replay matches only 8/20; others stop at divergence, no fabricated feedback. Complete offline analysis regeneration does not imply 20/20 policy replay or a field official gain. Post-exit N/types/case labels are offline only. Six formal results/codes/original encrypted logs and actual contestant manual review remain outstanding.
review_boundary: Independent automated review remains AI review. PDF visual review, archive replay and final research_review.json are recorded only after actual execution by the integration workflow; this descriptive file itself proves none of them.
